checks: The European Commission says many protected plant and animal souvenirs require a permit or certificate to enter the EU, including some items for personal use.
EU core destinations; wildlife imports from outside the applicable regulatory area
Verify the species, current annex, origin, documentary exemptions and designated customs offices. Special territories and export rules need separate review.
The UK authority lists CITES requirements for wildlife goods and narrow personal-luggage allowances for named specimens, subject to listed limits and packaging conditions.
Great Britain CITES scope; personal baggage
UK Animal and Plant Health Agency
Check species, weight, quantity, ports, directions and Northern Ireland arrangements before publication.
New Zealand DOC distinguishes permit requirements by species and origin, including a New Zealand-issued import permit for covered Appendix I items.
Check visitor luggage exceptions, actual specimen and exporter documentation.
DOC publishes export permit procedures for goods containing protected species.
New Zealand wildlife goods taken out of the country
Check specimen and local collection law separately. The destination may also require import documentation.
Singapore Customs identifies NParks as the authority for permits for CITES specimens before covered shipments enter or leave the country.
Singapore CITES controls; authority guidance aimed at trade
Singapore Customs and National Parks Board
Confirm whether any personal-baggage exception applies before giving visitor instructions.
Japan Customs requires advance declaration for entering or departing with covered means of payment above JPY 1 million or equivalent and publishes route- or item-specific provisions.
Japan passenger customs; means of payment and covered gold bullion
Check instrument type, separate bullion declaration, and any lower threshold or sanctions for the intended route.
Japan Customs requires arriving passengers to submit a declaration of accompanied and unaccompanied articles, with a digital option at supported locations.
Check family handling, route and paper/electronic submission options. Immigration and customs procedures are distinct.
Japan Customs gives separate departure procedures for covered foreign-made goods, means of payment and high-value or commercial articles.
Cross-check threshold boundaries with the dedicated means-of-payment page and verify tax-free goods rules separately.
The health ministry publishes personal-use quantity exemptions and guidance on obtaining import confirmation for medicines, with additional controls for certain substances.
Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare
Check ingredient, form, quantity and permits. General supply exemptions do not determine controlled-substance eligibility.
Singapore ICA requires an online declaration when entering or leaving with covered cash and bearer negotiable instruments totaling more than SGD 20,000 or equivalent.
Singapore entry and exit, personal cash and instruments
Check filing deadline, exemptions, possession and instruments. This does not establish other valuables or trade requirements.
Singapore HSA says a traveler may generally bring up to three months' supply only when prior approval is unnecessary and the medication is not prohibited.
Verify active ingredient, quantity, documentary conditions and transit rules.
Hong Kong Customs requires declaration above HKD 120,000 at specified arrival points and distinguishes officer-requested disclosure at other arrival points or departure.
Hong Kong SAR, currency and bearer negotiable instruments
Hong Kong Customs and Excise Department
Check covered checkpoints, airside transit exemption and equivalent currency rates. Do not extend to mainland China or Macau.
Australian Border Force requires reporting physical currency of AUD 10,000 or more or equivalent on entry or exit and distinguishes disclosure on request for bearer instruments.
Verify covered instruments, accompanying persons and route or reporting method.
Mexico's 2026 foreign-trade rules provide a declaration for cash and specified documents exceeding USD 10,000 or equivalent together.
Mexico customs, qualifying entry or exit
Check amendments, accepted declaration channels and exact instrument definition.
Mexico's customs agency publishes a declaration for passengers arriving from abroad that includes questions about money and baggage.
Check when the form is required, route-specific procedures and separate immigration documentation.
Brazil's tax authority requires an e-DBV declaration at entry with cash over USD 10,000 or equivalent.
Check reporting treatment of noncash instruments and separate departure procedures.
Brazil's tax authority requires an e-DBV on departure for cash above USD 10,000 or equivalent.
Review other currency forms, protected wildlife and goods-export restrictions separately.
Colombia DIAN describes Form 530 for covered currency or representative instruments exceeding USD 10,000 or equivalent on entry or exit.
Colombia National Tax and Customs Directorate
Check family group reporting, transport route, exact instrument and any separate limits.
DIAN's Form 530 instructions set out situations requiring a traveler baggage and money declaration.
Colombia National Tax and Customs Directorate
Check the trigger, immigration forms and any special archipelago arrivals separately.
Argentina's customs authority distinguishes cash entry declarations and outbound restrictions and gives separate guidance for Argentine currency and foreign currency.
Argentina passenger cash and negotiable instruments
Argentina Customs Revenue and Control Agency
Check direction, traveler age, conversion, instruments and exact threshold conditions.
Chile's agricultural authority requires travelers carrying covered regulated goods to declare them through the applicable sworn declaration process.
Chile arrivals; agricultural and animal-product declaration
Check paper or digital procedures at the port and separate customs and immigration declarations.
Chile's agricultural authority instructs arrivals to declare covered noncommercial animal and plant products regardless of amount. An inspector decides admissibility.
Chile agriculture and livestock border controls
Check exact products, origin, permits and separate island biosecurity controls.

SARS describes required online traveler declarations from 1 July 2026 for arrivals and departures through air, land, sea and rail. It describes assistance at the port for travelers who could not file in advance.
South African border ports; SARS online declaration rollout
Check exemptions, accessibility at the port and whether the requirement applies to the intended transit.
SARS includes departures in the online declaration process from 1 July 2026 and provides port assistance for travelers unable to complete it earlier.
South African departures through covered border ports
Review detailed outbound goods and monetary requirements separately.
The UAE federal authority describes disclosure above AED 60,000 or equivalent for covered cash, financial instruments and precious valuables when traveling to or from the UAE.
United Arab Emirates federal customs reporting
UAE Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security
Check current Afseh process, how family amounts count and precise valuation. A legacy Dubai Customs mobile page shows a different threshold.
A Dubai Customs mobile page gives an arrival threshold above AED 100,000, which differs from the federal authority and the standard Dubai Customs service page.
Dubai Customs mobile guidance; apparently legacy
Preserve the conflict and rely on verified current federal and port procedures before publication.
The health ministry's published resolution addresses procedures for passengers entering and leaving with medicines, including controlled medicines.
UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention
Check ingredient schedules, quantity, documentation and whether advance approval or border declaration applies.
ZATCA lists declarations on entry and exit for covered cash, instruments, metals or jewelry worth SAR 60,000 or more or equivalent.
Saudi Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority
Check how items are aggregated, proof requirements, exemptions and the current filing channel.
Fiji FIU says covered currency and bearer negotiable instruments of FJD 10,000 or more or foreign equivalent must be declared at the border on entry or exit.
Check outbound exchange controls and the applicable report separately.
Vanuatu Customs lists reporting for cash or negotiable bearer instruments around the VUV 1 million threshold; published descriptions differ on equality.
Vanuatu border cash and bearer instruments
Resolve the exact boundary and latest law against the Currency Declaration Act and border officer guidance.
Biosecurity Vanuatu specifies declaration of food, plants, animals, their products and covered equipment carried when arriving.
Check item-specific permits, ports and restrictions. Declaration does not permit import by itself.
Biosecurity Vanuatu describes a passenger arrival card and declaration of risk items for arriving air passengers.
Verify current digital or paper forms and separate rules for vessels.
Cook Islands Customs lists airport declaration for carried cash, precious gems or jewellery at the stated $10,000 threshold.
Cook Islands Ministry of Finance and Economic Management
Confirm valuation, legal currency basis, instruments and separately verify maritime and outbound routes.
Cook Islands Customs identifies goods and valuables that must be declared in the Rarotonga airport passenger declaration.
Cook Islands Ministry of Finance and Economic Management
Check the current arrival form, route and separate biosecurity or immigration requirements.
